description: Federate a tool call to another Canton MCP server (see list_canton_mcps). CCPEDIA proxies the call and returns the result, acting as one MCP that routes across the Canton MCP ecosystem. Only free, hosted, no-auth Canton MCPs can be proxied; local or paid ones return connect instructions instead. Canton-only.
